question: How should the enclosing worship and the world guardians be arranged?
premises: Worship should be performed in every way as a doubled enclosure.
Then the world guardians should be worshipped.
They are placed with their weapons in their own ten directions in order.
inference: The rite proceeds by doubled concentric worship followed by sequential installation of the world guardians in all ten directions.
plain_english: One should worship in every way as a doubled enclosure; then, in order, worship the world guardians with their weapons in their own ten directions.
